comment: I took the winter session version of Marketing 303 and I enjoyed the class. I am not a business major, and just needed an elective, so most of the material was new to me. Katie Gilstrap is really nice, and she emails back fast! Her tests are a little on the hard side, and there is some math in this class which I found myself working on a lot.
She means business, but she is good, funny and brings a lot to the topic. I wish she taught more classes here.

Takes several weeks to grade assignments, makes mistakes on blackboard and the syllabus, and is often unclear on what she expects from you. However, her lectures are well-structured to help you understand marketing, but not necessarily prepare for the tests (since she doesn't make them). Overall, very average- not the worst, but not the best.
